an4.7:1.1: “Bhikkhus, these four kinds of persons who are competent, disciplined, self-confident, learned, experts on the Dhamma, practicing in accordance with the Dhamma, adorn the Saṅgha.
an4.7:1.3: (1) “A bhikkhu who is competent, disciplined, self-confident, learned, an expert on the Dhamma, practicing in accordance with the Dhamma, adorns the Saṅgha.
an4.7:1.5: (3) A male lay follower who is competent …
an4.7:1.6: (4) A female lay follower who is competent, disciplined, self-confident, learned, an expert on the Dhamma, practicing in accordance with the Dhamma, adorns the Saṅgha.
an4.7:1.7: “Bhikkhus, these four kinds of persons who are competent, disciplined, self-confident, learned, upholders of the Dhamma, practicing in accordance with the Dhamma, adorn the Saṅgha.”
an4.7:2.1: One who is competent and self-confident,
an4.7:2.2: learned, an expert on the Dhamma,
an4.7:2.3: practicing in accord with the Dhamma,
an4.7:2.4: is called an adornment of the Saṅgha.
an4.7:3.3: a male lay follower endowed with faith,
an4.7:3.4: a female lay follower endowed with faith:
an4.7:3.5: these are the ones that adorn the Saṅgha;
